stories.title: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
stories.explanation: Anthropic reportedly priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its projected range, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. This indicates strong investor confidence in the AI sector and Anthropic's market position.

stories.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, new frontier models offering improved professional outputs, coding, and efficiency at lower costs across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API. This represents a significant advancement in their model capabilities and accessibility.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
stories.explanation: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier-level AI model for complex coding, analysis, and science workflows, which ranks highly on intelligence and steerability indices. This represents a significant advancement in Google's AI model capabilities and performance.

stories.title: Genie 4 is now available
stories.explanation: Google made Genie 4 available to Google AI Ultra subscribers, allowing them to generate and interact with digital worlds using natural language, real-time audio, and editing features. This expands Google's AI capabilities into interactive world creation for users.

stories.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
stories.explanation: OpenAI explained its approach to managing frontier AI risk from training to deployment, including model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring. This demonstrates OpenAI's commitment to safety and responsible development of advanced AI models.

stories.title: America’s AI Chip War Is Heating Up in the Dumbest Possible Ways
stories.explanation: The Trump administration announced new plans to restrict China's access to advanced AI chips, including remote access to overseas data centers and stricter rules for shipments to certain countries. This represents a significant escalation in the US-China AI chip war.

stories.title: Artex Is Criminals’ New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
stories.explanation: Artex and similar AI-powered penetration testing tools are being used by cybercriminals to autonomously scan for vulnerabilities and launch attacks. This signifies a new era where AI agents are significantly speeding up cybercriminal capabilities.

stories.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
stories.explanation: NVIDIA announced new tools for AI agents, including Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU, and an expanded Vera CPU platform, at SC26. This aims to accelerate scientific research through advanced AI and computing infrastructure.

stories.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
stories.explanation: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B on Hugging Face, a new model built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning, showing improved performance on agent tasks and various reasoning benchmarks. This contributes to the open-source AI model ecosystem with a focus on post-training efficiency.

stories.title: What’s new in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026
stories.explanation: Microsoft announced new capabilities in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026 across the agent lifecycle, including the managed Microsoft Copilot harness and richer tool connections. These updates aim to help developers build, deploy, and operate more capable AI agents at scale.
